Name: Triple Shot Espresso (Grande)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
I created this simple mod because I can't be bothered to drink coffee or Triple Shot Espresso multiple times a day.

Recipe mail will be sent when Gus' friendship level is Heart 3 or higher and Triple Espresso recipe mastered.

Just this.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Version 2.1~[/size][/color]
Added “Buffs” to the ModConfig settings.
You can now make the Speed Buff effect even more powerful or add other buff effects.


[size=4]The "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23352]Customize Coffee Maker[/url]" can output aTriple Shot Espresso (Grande)![/size]


English and Japanese and Chinese and French are supported.

Downloads.Description:
Due to an issue where buff effects carried over to the next day under specific conditions, buffs now disappear the moment you wake up.
Added an option to adjust the buffs obtained through ModConfig settings.
